title: Round Trip
summary: Boss: a whole analysis in Python. Do women and men start flying at different ages? Import, describe, plot, check, test, and write the APA sentence with an f-string.

steps.title: Import
steps.summary: Import pandas, numpy, scipy.stats, seaborn and pyplot; read the log; make `first` with `age`.

steps.title: Describe
steps.summary: `by_sex`: count, mean and std of age for each sex.

steps.title: Plot
steps.summary: A boxplot of age by sex, y label "Age at first flight", then plt.show().

steps.title: Check
steps.summary: `women` and `men` (their ages); Levene's test centred on the mean in `levene`.

steps.title: Test
steps.summary: Welch's t (women first) in `welch`; Cohen's d (pooled SD) in `d`.

steps.title: Write it up
steps.summary: `decision`, and an APA `sentence` built with an f-string: M, t(df), p and d.

hints: Step 5: `stats.ttest_ind(women, men, equal_var=False)`; d = (mean of women − mean of men) / pooled SD.
Step 6: `p_text = "p < .001" if welch.pvalue < .001 else f"p = {welch.pvalue:.3f}".replace("0.", ".", 1)`, then `sentence = f"... t({welch.df:.2f}) = {welch.statistic:.2f}, {p_text}, d = {d:.2f}."`.
